description:
Load a sample wind turbine project and modify the blade geometry to introduce sweep and pre-bend. 

1. Open QBlade and load the 'HAWT_Start.wpa' (or similar HAWT) project from `/home/ga/Documents/sample_projects/`.
2. Go to the Blade Design module and select the blade.
3. Modify the TIP section (the last row in the geometry table) with the following values:
   - X-Offset (Sweep): 2.0 m
   - Y-Offset (Pre-bend): 1.5 m
4. Save the modified project as `/home/ga/Documents/projects/swept_blade.wpa`.
5. Export the blade geometry as an STL file to `/home/ga/Documents/projects/swept_blade.stl`.
